title: Music City Magic Luxury Townhome, Balcony, Garage
description:
Music City Magic

The space
Music City Magic is a three-story, four-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome with 2,017 square feet of living space and room for up to eight guests. The sleeping layout is two single beds in Bedroom 1, one king bed in Bedroom 2, two single beds in Bedroom 3, and one double bed in Bedroom 4.

The open main level includes a comfortable living area with Roku TV and sound system, a dining space, and a full gourmet kitchen with stainless-steel appliances. Step outside to the furnished balcony, or use the private garage for convenient on-site parking.

Wi-Fi, central air and heat, and in-building washer and dryer access are included. The home is a short drive from Germantown, downtown Nashville, The Gulch, Broadway, the Farmers' Market, and First Horizon Park.

Pets are welcome. Smoking and parties are not allowed. Check-in is 4:00 PM and checkout is 10:00 AM.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
